The '''Allandor system''' was [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Freeworlds Territory]] border region of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was situated between the [[Neona system/Legends|Neona]] and [[Sheva system/Legends|Sheva systems]].
